spans.s:
(इ) वगि r. 1st cl. (वंगति)
1 To go.
2 To go lamely, to limp.

f. (-गा)
A bridle.

m. (-हः)
Bathing, ablution.
E.
अव before गाह to agitate, aff. अच्, and the initial rejected; also अवगाह.

m. (-ग्नुः)
A speaker.
E.
वच to speak, नु Uṇādi aff., and च changed to ग.

m. (-कः)
1 A stealer of books.
2 A reader of prohibited works or passages.
E.
वाक् speech, अपहारक seizer, stealer.

m. (-रः)
1 A sage, a holy man, one desirous of final emancipation.
2 A scholar, a Paṇḍita, a learned

Brahman.
3

A hero, a brave man, one who is intrepid or fearless.
4 Certainty, ascertainment.
5 A whetstone.
6 An obstacle, an impediment, or cause of obstruction.
7 Submarine fire.
8 A wolf.
E.
वाक् speech, ऋ to go, aff. अप्.

f. (-सिः)
Sharp or searching speech.
E.
वाच्, and असि a sword, piercing men's thoughts.

mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु)
Breaking promise or faith, disappointing, a disappointer or deceiver.
E.
वाक् speech, ऋ to go, उण् aff.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Eloquent, well spoken.
m. (-शः)
1 An author, an orator, a poet, &c.
2 BRAHMĀ.
E.
वाक् speech, ईश master.

m. (-रः)
1 An orator, a learned man.
2 A Bauddha deified sage; also MAÑ

JUGHOṢA.
2

BRAHMĀ.
f. (-री)
SARASVATĪ.
E.
वाक् speech, ईश्वर lord.

f. (-जी)
A plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
वाच् speech, गुज to sound inarticulately, aff. क, form irr.

m. (-णः)
An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.)

f. (-रा)
A net, a snare, a noose.
E.
वा to hurt, उर Uṇādi aff., and गन् augment.

f. (-त्तिः)
Catching wild animals.
E.
वागुरा a snare, and वृत्ति practice.

m. (-कः)
A hunter, a deer-catcher.
E.
वागुरा a net, aff. ठक्.

m. (-भः)
A learned or eloquent man.
E.
वाच्, and ऋषभ best.

n. (-त्वं)
Eloquence, learning, erudition.
E.
वागृषभ, and त्व aff.

m. (-दः)
A sort of bird.
E.
वाक् speech, गुद to sport, aff. क.

m. (-लिः)
The betel-bearer, an officer or servant whose business it is to have the box of Pān ready for his prince or master.
E.
वाक् speech, (command,) गुर to obey, कि aff., and र changed to ल, or गृ to swallow, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A betel-bearer.
E.
ठक् pleonasm, added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
Graceful or eloquent language.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 Reproof, reprimand.
2 Restraint or controul of speech.
E.
वाक्, and दण्ड punishment.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Promised.
f. (-त्ता)
A virgin betrothed.
E.
वाच्, and दत्त given.

mf. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Of few words, speaking little and humbly or guardedly.
E.
वाक् speech, दरिद्र poor.

n. (-लं)
A lip.
E.
वाक् speech, दल a leaf.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Abusive, ill-spoken, speaking ill, either morally or grammatically.
m. (-ष्टः)
A Brahman who has past the proper time of life, without receiving the initiatory Mantra, the investiture of the thread, &c.
E.
वाक् speech, दुष्ट bad, faulty.

f. (-ता)
1 VṚ

HASPATI.
2

An eloquent man or writer.
E.
वाच्, and देवता divinity.

f. (-वी)
A name of SARASVATĪ.
E.
वाक् speech, and देवी goddess, the goddess of eloquence.

m. (-षः)
1 Speaking ill, defamation, abuse.
2 Ungrammatical speech.
3 Uttering a disagreeable sound.
E.
वाक्, and दोष fault.

n. (-नं)
Silencing, stopping any one's speech.
E.
वाक्, and वन्धन obstructing.

mfn. (-ग्मी-ग्मिनी-ग्मि)
1 Loquacious, talkative, speaking much.
2 Speaking well, eloquent.
m. (-ग्मी)
A name of VṚHASPATI.
E.
वाच् speech, ग्मिनि aff.; hence also वागिमन्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having root or origin in speech.
E.
वाच्, and मूल root.

n. (-त्रं)
Mere speech, words alone.
E.
वाच्, and मात्र only.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
1 Speaking little, and cautiously or humbly.
2 Speaking truly.
m. (-ग्यः)
1 Humility, self-disparagement.
2 Doubt, alternative (?)
E.
वाच् speech, यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reserved in speech, taciturn, silent.
E.
वाक्, and यत restrained.

ind.
Silently.
E.
वाग्य speaking little, तसि aff.

m. (-मः)
A dumb man, one silent from necessity.
E.
वाच् speech, यम to restrain, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Emitted or put forth by speech.
E.
वाच्, and विनिःसृत issued.

m. (-सः)
Graceful or elegant speech.
E.
वाक्, and विलास sport.

m. (-रः)
1 Manner, style or habit of speaking.
2 Customary phraseology.
E.
वाक्, and व्यापार usual practice.
